omissions_and_simplifications: ACTIVE TRADE-OFF INTERROGATION FINDING 1 (Solver Decoupling): CaseConstraintSolver is preloaded in CaseGenerator.gd (const CASE_CONSTRAINT_SOLVER) and fully implemented/tested in tests/test_case_generator_fuzz.py, but CaseGenerator.gd retains its internal procedural placement routine (_hidden_draft) and delegates public solver queries to CaseGeneratorPublicSolver.gd rather than calling CaseConstraintSolver.solve_board_positioning().
